notes.title: 1.3 Lite Mode + Sheep Counter Bugfix
notes.content:
[b]Performance mode:[/b]
Added a "Lite Mode" option for lower-end PCs. This reduces particle effects and other performance-heavy visuals which should help stability in busier parts of the game. You can toggle it from the main menu.
[b]
Major Bugfix:[/b]
Fixed an issue that was causing the Moon Sheep counter to indicate more attrition than was accurate in
certain mid-early terrestrial sections of the game. 
The number should now move in a more stable fashion and accurately reflect actual sheep losses in these areas.
[b]
Minor Bugfix:[/b]
-Final Space Goose upgrade now shows the normal upgrade effect. 

Version will now read 1.3 in the main menu.

notes.title: Hotfix for upgrade error
notes.content: Quick hotfix for some players showing an error after previous patch in end game section.

notes.title: Crash and end-game content fix.
notes.content:
Fixed crashes on certain upgrade paths in the end game. 
Fixed certain situations where players can no longer upgrade relevant items in the final section of the game. 
Slightly adjusted some in game prices at end game.

notes.title: Money hotfix
notes.content: Just fixed a couple of instances where the upgrade text displayed an incorrect wool price increase amount.
